Our remote digital identity verification supports customizable online and in-branch consumer experiences. Job Description: We are seeking a motivated and talented Junior QA Automation Engineer with a background in programming and experience in testing web-based applications (AngularJS preferred) for an 8 month co-op placement. As a co-op student, you will collaborate closely with our development and quality assurance teams to design, implement, and execute automated tests, ensuring the delivery of high-quality software to our clients. Note: there will be some manual testing involved in this role. The ideal candidate is meticulous, detail-oriented, and possesses an understanding of quality assurance methodologies, and software development processes. Responsibilities • Collaborate with the QA team to develop and maintain automated test scripts for the backend and front end. • Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand software requirements, design test scenarios, and create comprehensive test plans. • Execute automated tests to validate software functionality, identify defects, and ensure optimal performance. • Read, understand and follow test scripts. Must be able to help put together meaningful and complete test scrips based on software flows and test plans. • Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot, reproduce, and report software defects, and track their resolution. • Continuously enhance and update automated test suites to accommodate new features, improvements, and changes. • Participate in code reviews and contribute to the improvement of software quality by identifying opportunities for automation and process enhancements. • Monitor and analyze test results, generate reports, and provide valuable insights to the development team. • Conduct Website testing and automated scripting. Contribute to a culture of quality and excellence, sharing best practices and fostering continuous improvement within the QA team. • Other • As we are a fully remote organization, we ask all employees to use their own computer and in exchange we will give a monthly allowance to help cover depreciation costs. Salary range: $26.00 - $28.80/hr depending on experience Job Requirements Qualifications • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. • Previous experience in a QA role is a benefit, specifically working web testing frameworks, API testing (swagger, readyApi, postman) • Familiarity with test automation tools and languages, preferably Playwright. • Understanding of web application testing principles, methodologies, and best practices. • Experience with testing AngularJS-based applications, including components, services, and UI interactions. • • Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines. Knowledge of agile software development methodologies and the role of QA within the development lifecycle. • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to diagnose, track, and manage defects effectively. • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams. • Detail-oriented mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality software products. Adaptability to a fast-paced environment and a willingness to learn and embrace new technologies. • Citizenship Requirement N/A APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through UBC Science Co-op Cover Letter Required?
